From install to first draft in fifteen minutes

Your GRC data stays in a private grc/ folder in your project, as Markdown and CSV you can version, diff and move to any platform later.

  1. Install the skills

    Run npx skills add grcmana/grcskills and pick your agent.

  2. Give it your context

    Ask your agent to run company-context. Point it at your website and existing docs, or answer a few short batches of questions.

  3. Ask for the work

    "Build our risk register." "Are we ready for ISO 27001 Stage 1?" "Do we need a DPIA for this feature?"

Built the way an auditor would want it

Specific to you
Every skill works from your company profile, so outputs name your real tools, data and suppliers instead of generic threats.
People approve
Skills draft and propose. Risk acceptance, policy approval and audit conclusions stay with a named person.
Honest about sources
Framework knowledge is written in our own words, references clause IDs, and carries a review date, so you know when to check the official source.

Want the whole workspace?

GRC OS bundles every skill with operating instructions, guardrails, permission defaults and a worked example of a fictional 45-person SaaS company. Clone it, open it in Claude Code, and say hi.
